subject: Taxes
title: The Paradise Papers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Paradise Papers.

hook.text: In 2017, the Paradise Papers exposed 13.4 million documents from offshore law firm Appleby.

buildup.text: The leak revealed offshore interests of Nike, Apple, Uber, Queen Elizabeth II's estate, and the US Commerce Secretary.

discovery.text: Apple shifted its tax residency from Ireland to Jersey after the EU challenged its Irish arrangements.

twist.text: Unlike Panama, Appleby claimed everything was legal.

climax.text: The Paradise Papers showed that closing one loophole just opens another. Havens adapt faster than regulators legislate.

punchline.text: Close one door, they find another. Offshore finance always adapts.

quiz.question: What did Apple do when the EU challenged its Irish tax arrangements?
options: Shifted tax residency from Ireland to Jersey
